kv_backend_note: the model refuses a contiguous cache: its engine capabilities set requiresPagedKV and the engine build fails on a non-paged backend. This is the one backend the track can serve.
baseline_reference_commit_note: the seed commit of THIS engine repository (the tree-identical copy of the source engine). It is the newest commit that pre-dates the identity commit the contract is written in, so it is an ANCESTOR of the reference tree of record. The lead re-pins it to the identity commit once that commit exists; a commit cannot contain its own sha.
mlx_swift_lm_revision_note: a TREE, not a commit: the vendored tree is the local merge of 62cfabd5c67c6042edcfd812698bd34e4b5df7d7 and 443789360ddbf804d55d063ca9cda4ea2d3013a9, and no upstream commit names that merge. Nothing in the tree reads this field as a commit.

config_fixture.source: config.json of the pinned snapshot, downloaded from the Hub at the pinned revision and hashed with shasum -a 256

rope_theta_by_layer.note: layer_rope_theta in config.json is 500000.0 on every sliding layer and 0 on every full layer, i.e. the full layers are NoPE

components.vision: present in the checkpoint, not loaded by this text-only track

target.experts: none: model.safetensors.index.json holds no experts tensor
target.manifest_path_note: the target checkpoint's SHA256 file list, written by tools/new-track.sh from the published tree. The FILE NAME is inherited from the source track because setup.sh names that path by default and setup.sh is outside this part's editable set; only the name is inherited, every record in it is nvidia/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4 @ 4781837.

quantization.weight_packing: 8 four-bit codes per uint32: shape [out, in / 8]
quantization.scale_format: float8 e4m3, one scale per 16 inputs of a weight row
quantization.authority: config.json quantization_config: quant_algo MIXED_PRECISION, a float8 group over 180 modules and a 4-bit group-16 NVFP4 group over 213 modules, plus the shard headers on the staged checkpoint

license.source: the LICENSE file of the pinned snapshot (nvidia/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4 at 4781837), read from the published tree

mtp_head.note: the key keeps its name because mtp-head.manifest.json is the declaration slot the trusted harness reads; the decoder this track declares there is dflash, and the artifact is the quantized DFlash drafter, not an MTP layer
mtp_head.manifest_path_note: the head slot's manifest, inherited by name from the source track for the same reason as target.manifest_path. It pins nothing yet: the drafter is PRODUCED from the pinned assistant repository, not downloaded, and its identity is the artifact pin below.

artifact.writer: the pinned DFlash artifact writer with the pinned quantized plan: MLP projections 5-bit affine at group 64, attention projections and the encoder output projection 8-bit, norms dense
artifact.pinned_at: Vendor/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/MuseGlimmer/DFlash/MuseGlimmerDFlashLoading.swift (the quantized artifact pin), byte count from that pin's own comment

source_artifact.note: the published BF16 drafter the quantized artifact is produced from, pinned at the same library file

scoring_semantics.formula: composite = prefill_gain ^ 0.25 * decode_gain ^ 0.75. Per component: gain = control / candidate per-token time (serial-anchored -- a faster candidate scores > 1). Decode per-token time is the decode window: decode-run time / N, with no seed prefill in it. The run is PAIRED on the box: official_pairs pairs, each one serial-control leg on the organizer-staged reference tree and one candidate leg at the declared DFlash draft depth, single-stream (scored_batch_size 1). Pair k measures live_goldens[(k - 1) mod N], so each live golden gets the same number of pairs. The score is the mean of the per-pair composites (official_pair_combine: mean). Floors and the ceiling apply to every pair.
